_comment: Commands every pattern family must decide alike: the Claude Code, grok and opencode globs (fnmatch stand-in, whole command), the Gemini CLI regexes (loader port) and the Kimi hook. Text only, never run. Kept out of the suite: pr-guard reads the suite and refuses the merge commands.
refuse: geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x
geectl request refile --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x --supersede 1
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x --live
geectl request refile --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x --supersede 1 --live
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-package pkg --changes-entry x --description x --target-project openSUSE:Factory
geectl request refile --supersede 1 --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x
pass: geectl local-build build --project openSUSE_Tumbleweed --repo standard --arch x86_64 . --live
geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-project devel:x --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x --live

geectl request file --source-project home:x --source-package pkg --target-proj openSUSE:Factory --target-package pkg --description x --changes-entry x
